name: Probability Course: Stochara
subtitle: Probability practice, adaptive
shortDescription: Adaptive probability course with six 3D labs: Galton beads, random walks, Monte Carlo, Bayes crowds, birthdays, Markov chains. Chosen-length quizzes.
longDescription:
Stochara is an adaptive, interactive undergraduate probability course.

### Learn it your way
A personalised path that adapts to your mistakes and schedules reviews, or the traditional syllabus order. Switch any time.

### What you will master
Sample spaces and axioms, counting and combinations, conditional probability, independence, Bayes' rule, random variables, expectation and variance, binomial, geometric and Poisson distributions, continuous variables, the normal distribution, joint distributions and covariance, the law of large numbers, the central limit theorem, moment generating functions, Markov chains and Monte Carlo methods.

### Practice that explains itself
Original problems with full worked solutions, a note on the habit behind each wrong answer, unit checkpoints and a timed mock exam.

### Six 3D Labs
Start from a real problem and explore it in 3D: beads falling through a Galton board, dust walkers diffusing, darts thrown into a crate to estimate pi and a volume, a screening crowd of 1000 people for Bayes' rule, a birthday and coupon ring, and a web surfer on a Markov chain. Each lab shows live formulas and a second method that checks the answer, and opens its cited sources in an in-app window.

### Your Level, Your Length
Pick 5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number of questions, from beginner to research-level, adaptive or in course order. Mock exams stay ad-free.

### Never stuck
Tap any concept for a plain-language refresher from earlier maths, with pointers to what comes next. Every source is cited and linked in the app.

Free to use. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never during a test, and every explanation stays free. An optional monthly plan removes ads. Not affiliated with any university, publisher or course mentioned; they are cited as references only.
whatsNew: Six new 3D labs with live formulas and second-method checks, quizzes of the length you choose, and levels from beginner to research-level.
